summary: Iteration 161: Complete testing of Shareable Replay Links and Dashboard Collapsible Sections features. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All 14 frontend UI tests passed. Dashboard collapsible sections work correctly with proper badge counts. Replay page share moment feature generates timestamped URLs that auto-seek when opened.

integration_issues.issue: Clipboard copy shows 'Failed to copy' in headless browser mode - this is a browser security restriction requiring secure context and user gesture. Works correctly in manual testing.
integration_issues.note: Browser limitation in automated testing, not a code bug
